matches.rationale: The ground truth concerns a conceptual flaw in Section 2 regarding Ext-symmetry of Jacobian algebras and the Jacobian-ness of generalized preprojective algebras (needed to justify applying GLS's multiplication formula). None of the four findings address this issue; they instead flag unrelated notational/logical concerns in Sections 3.2, 2.3/2.4 quiver matching, Proposition 4.3's proof, and Theorem 4.1's notation.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Writing Ext^1=1 to mean the Ext-group is one-dimensional is standard informal shorthand in this literature, so this is a misreading rather than a real defect, and it does not correspond to the GT issue.
This claims a mismatch between Q_GLS and Q^-_GLS(c) but appears to misread the construction of M^{-∞} and does not correspond to the GT's Jacobian/Ext-symmetry issue.
Points to a plausible logical gap in the proof of Proposition 4.3 that is unrelated to the GT defect about Jacobian algebras and Ext-symmetry.
Flags a notational inconsistency in Theorem 4.1 unrelated to the GT's conceptual issue in Section 2.
